decisions.name: September 2 EGLE statewide wastewater and biosolids PFAS report
decisions.reason: The June 2020 EGLE report is distinct and was retained once in the PFAS library. It documents statewide IPP and wastewater/biosolids findings but does not name Cadillac or Wexford or supply a local analytical result, so no Cadillac timeline event was added and no evidence-request requirement was closed.

decisions.name: September 2 EPA quarterly noncompliance reports
decisions.reason: The January–March 2014 and April–June 2014 files are exact byte matches to established records and were not added again; their canonical assets were localized for anonymous preview and download. The January–March 2015 file is distinct and was retained once. The later 2014 report carries forward the same December 31, 2013 DMR reporting violation, so it is linked as a cross-reference rather than counted as another violation event. The 2015 report lists seven ammonia and carbonaceous-BOD entries but supplies no concentrations, loads, root cause, PFAS finding, linked enforcement action or final order.

decisions.name: September 2 Cadillac FY2019 adopted operating budget
decisions.reason: The 235-page budget is a distinct May 21, 2018 record and is not merged with the November 20, 2017 Council minutes. It reports FY2017 actual, FY2018 estimated and FY2019 proposed leachate revenue and places an additional-hauled-waste revenue goal next to NPDES, industrial-monitoring and Class A biosolids goals. This supports noting a potential policy tension, not asserting that a conflict, violation or causal relationship occurred.

decisions.name: September 2 Cadillac November 20, 2017 official minutes
decisions.reason: The official minutes are a distinct nine-page municipal record, not another copy of the 102-page council packet or the unsigned proposed-resolution attachment. Pages 6 through 8 establish that Cadillac was paid to treat landfill leachate, describe its collection and hauling to the WWTP, record Cadillac's treatment and environmental discharge role, and document unanimous approval of motion 2017-232. The record is retained once and linked as a primary source; it does not supply transaction-level loads, invoices, an exact final delivery date, PFAS concentrations or migration-pathway proof.

decisions.name: September 1 USGS 04121241 Clam River discharge tables
decisions.reason: The three supplied CSVs are exact members of the established USGS ZIP package. They are exposed as individual searchable and downloadable table records for station identity, field measurements and channel measurements while the ZIP remains the canonical preserved package. The tables document ten approved discrete surface-water discharge observations, not continuous flow, PFAS results, groundwater direction or a contaminant pathway.

decisions.name: September 1 EGLE AOI multi-agency testing packet
decisions.reason: The supplied PDF exactly matches the established 24-page 1140 Plett source packet. It contains a side-by-side results summary, selected EGLE Work Order 2509147 pages, Merit reports, Cyclopure reports and an EGLE transmittal letter. The packet is now linked directly to the AOI event, but the evidence queue remains open for the complete 49-page work order and chain-of-custody forms.

decisions.name: September 1 EGLE/MPART AOI excerpt intake

The complete official sources are reused and the report is localized for first-page preview and full download. The receptor detections and exceedance markings strengthen AOI context, but the report expressly states that the study was not intended as a PFAS source investigation; no unsigned-resolution, exact-final-delivery or source-to-receptor requirement is closed.

decisions.name: September 1 Plett infrastructure and hydrogeology intake

The official Wellogic package closes only the local well-construction/lithology requirement. It does not close the requests for a certified 1140 Plett log, surveyed synoptic water levels, hydraulic tests or a site-specific groundwater-flow map.
